name: PocketBase

evidence.backend: C02: backend platform with database, auth, files, realtime and hooks; C07 confirmed
evidence.sql: D01: embedded SQLite with typed collections as tables; SQL views supported
evidence.files: C07: local or S3-backed file storage; F05: external S3-compatible bucket option
evidence.jobs: C07: scheduled jobs; J04: recurring cron jobs with IDs and expressions

line: Self-hosted backend with SQLite, auth, file uploads, and realtime APIs.

free.text: Free MIT software; you supply hosting and storage

cells.metered: Software $0; server, data, and network costs are yours
cells.selfhost: Yes, MIT server or Go library

sql.math: $0 software fee. The server, disk, backups and 5 GB of transfer depend on the infrastructure provider you choose.
The license stays $0. Kept host, database, files, backups and provider minimums are not priced.

files.math: $0 software fee. 100 GB of files, requests, delivery and backups depend on the host or S3 provider you choose.

jobs.math: Handlers and cron have no job fee, but they share server resources that are not priced. They do not provide durable queue delivery.
